data.adapter:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
shift 2
database=$1
shift 2
exec psql -h "$database" "$@"

containers.name: migrate
command:
mkdir -p /tmp/migrations/replica /tmp/migrations/transactional
for group in replica transactional; do
    for path in /sql/"$group"-*.sql; do
        name=${path##*/}
        cp "$path" "/tmp/migrations/$group/${name#*-}"
    done
done
cd /tmp
sh /sql/migrate.sh /sql/adapter

containers.name: topics
command:
for topic in purchase-events analytics-results; do
    /opt/kafka/bin/kafka-topics.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --create --if-not-exists         --topic "$topic" --partitions 3 --replication-factor 1
done
